data.name: Moujib
data.gender_notes: Moujib is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'mwj' which means 'to send'. The name Moujib signifies a gift or blessing bestowed upon someone. The name Moujib carries the meaning “Gift, Blessing” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Moujib usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, blessing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Moujib belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift, Blessing.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Moujib total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Moujib, with its Arabic origin and meaning, plays an essential role in the Islamic culture. By bestowing the name upon a child, parents wish for blessings, success, and prosperity in their lives. It becomes a reminder that every individual is a recipient of Allah's grace and favors.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual standpoint, the name Moujib resonates with the concept of Tawakkul, or complete reliance on Allah. The name signifies the belief that all blessings and gifts come from Allah, and ultimately, every success and achievement is a result of His will and grace. Thus, by naming their child Moujib, parents are instilling a sense of trust and dependence on Allah, encouraging their child to seek His guidance and favor in all aspects of life.
